name: SoftBank Group

summary.text: SoftBank Group Corp. is a Tokyo-listed investment holding company founded by Masayoshi Son. Its SoftBank Vision Fund, which held a first close of more than $93 billion in May 2017, was backed by up to $45 billion from Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund and $15 billion from Abu Dhabi's Mubadala, with SoftBank itself committing $28 billion including a stake in chip designer Arm, of which SoftBank remains majority owner. In 2025 SoftBank led OpenAI's $40 billion funding round, co-founded the Stargate data-center venture with OpenAI and Oracle, and sold its entire Nvidia stake for $5.83 billion to fund its OpenAI commitment.

facts.claim: On May 20, 2017, SoftBank Group and Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund announced the first close of the SoftBank Vision Fund with more than $93 billion in commitments, targeting $100 billion. PIF agreed to invest up to $45 billion over five years, Mubadala committed $15 billion, SoftBank committed $28 billion (including $8.2 billion through the transfer of a 24.99 percent stake in Arm), and Apple, Foxconn, Qualcomm and Sharp invested about $1 billion each.
facts.quote: PIF will invest up to $45 billion in the Vision Fund over the next five years.

facts.claim: In March 2025 OpenAI announced a $40 billion funding round led by SoftBank at a $300 billion post-money valuation, with SoftBank contributing about $30 billion and Microsoft, Coatue, Altimeter and Thrive the rest. In December 2025 CNBC reported SoftBank had completed the investment, having sent a final $22.5 billion after syndicating $10 billion and investing $8 billion earlier.
facts.quote: SoftBank Group sent over the final $22 billion to $22.5 billion investment last week after it had syndicated $10 billion and invested $8 billion in OpenAI, the report said.

facts.claim: Stargate, announced by President Trump in January 2025, is a joint venture of SoftBank, OpenAI and Oracle to invest in U.S. AI data-center infrastructure. In January 2026 OpenAI and SoftBank announced a $1 billion investment in SoftBank's SB Energy as part of the buildout.
facts.quote: Stargate is a joint venture between SoftBank, OpenAI and Oracle that was announced by President Donald Trump in January.

facts.claim: SoftBank disclosed in November 2025 that it had sold its entire Nvidia position of 32.1 million shares in October for about $5.83 billion, along with part of its T-Mobile stake for $9.17 billion; a person familiar told CNBC these sales and a margin loan on its Arm holding were sources of cash for its $22.5 billion OpenAI investment. The Vision Fund had earlier built a roughly $4 billion Nvidia stake in 2017 and divested it in January 2019.

facts.claim: SoftBank is the majority shareholder of Arm Holdings, controlling roughly 90 percent of shares outstanding after Arm's 2023 initial public offering; reports in 2025 said SoftBank took an $8.5 billion margin loan against its Arm stock to help fund its OpenAI investment.
